note: Cached canonical HTML contract essentials from learn_post_authoring. Reuse across daily runs.

established_template.description: AI Current dark theme. Each block wrapped in a node-section div with data-background-color #222222 and (for text blocks) data-color #FFFFFF, padding 20. Cover image is a 16:9 imageBlock figure with 30px rounded corners in a section with NO data-color. Story sections use h2 headings (e.g. Model Releases, Agents & Products, Funding & Deals, Policy & Governance). Intro paragraph section after cover; sign-off paragraph + full-width 'Share AI Current' button ({{rp_referral_hub_url}}) at the end. Source links use (Source) at the end of each item.

ad_placement_learnings.primary_slot_limit: A post supports only ONE 'primary' (hero, with-logo) ad slot. Placing data-advertisement-kind=primary on more than one ad fails with 'No primary ad slot is available'. Use data-advertisement-kind=secondary for all additional ads.
ad_placement_learnings.accepted_opportunity_cap: The ad network caps accepted opportunities (~3). If 3 are already 'accepted' (status via list_ad_opportunities), placing a NEW offer from list_ad_offers fails with 'can not accept any more opportunities'. In that case place the already-accepted opportunities (list_ad_opportunities status=accepted) rather than accepting new offers. The daily pipeline pre-accepts 3 opportunities dated for the current send window.
ad_placement_learnings.email_settings_keys: Use email_subject_line and email_preview_text (NOT subject_line/preview_text) in save_post/edit_post email_settings; wrong keys are silently ignored and default to title/subtitle.
ad_placement_learnings.audience: Publication has NO paid tiers (list_tiers returns 0). Omit recipients on save_post to default to free tier on web + email, matching all prior posts.
